title: Answer the Australian Statistician's directions to provide information
what: A person directed by the Statistician to provide information (for example, in an ABS business survey) must comply.

sources.title: Census and Statistics Act 1905
sources.quote: 14 Failure to answer questions etc. (1) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person is served a direction under subsection 10(4) or 11(2); and (b) the person fails to comply with the direction.
